slot_scores.name: purchase_beginning_of_month_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the decision to purchase and sell made at the beginning of each month, with the resulting stock level
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about beginning-of-month purchase timing, but it did not explicitly confirm whether units purchased in a month are available for sale in that same month or how purchase timing relates to sales timing. The semantic rule is therefore only partially covered.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchased units in a month are available for sale in that same month; inventory balance is I_t = I_{t-1} + P_t - S_t.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent confirmed only that the purchase decision occurs at the beginning of each month, not that current-month purchases can be sold in the same month or the ordering of purchases versus sales. It then assumed this timing in the inventory balance.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while H1 was only partially resolved, because it did not confirm whether beginning-of-month purchases are available for sale in the same month.

summary: The agent clarified several basic parameter and constraint facts and explicitly asked about purchase timing, but it stopped before fully resolving whether beginning-of-month purchases are available for sale in the same month.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
